messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: צורת החישוב של - scores ב PCA
parts: You put cor=T in the princomp call. This scales the input matrix using correlation instead if covariance (its ok its better this way), thus making your results standardized and better for comparison. If you want to see the results in orig scale run cor=F.

when you use the correlation matrix the fit$scale should be taken into account when calculating the scores.
(by the way, you also need to center the data (this applies to COV too

scale(csv.data,fit$center,fit$scale)%*%fit$loadings
